IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SiteNavPermission') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[SiteNavPermission]( [SiteNavID] [int] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_SiteNavPermission] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [SiteNavID] ASC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) )
END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_SiteNavPermission_SiteNavID') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[SiteNavPermission] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_SiteNavPermission_SiteNavID] FOREIGN KEY([SiteNavID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[SiteNav] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[SiteNavPermission] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_SiteNavPermission_SiteNavID] END
